plan.goal: Build a personal news reader that learns worthwhile interests, supports broad exploration, rejects attention optimization, and separates model learning from self-reported human learning.
plan.deliverable: Private responsive news reader with constrained editions, experimental epistemic personalization, two separate trackers, and evaluation evidence.

research.boundary: Verified EG/EEG equations; explicit usefulness feedback, cold-start content model, sampled catalog and user-learning tracker are app adaptations, not evaluated paper findings. No transferred coverage guarantees.

source_plan.additional_sources_policy: Report thin or absent subject domains to the user; add further feeds only with approval.
source_plan.coverage_assessment_status: provisional_source_mix_review; rolling content audit not yet performed

success_criteria: Primary: paired interest-prediction Brier-score reduction versus a frozen onboarding-only baseline on broadly sampled calibration cards; report counts, versions, response rate and descriptive uncertainty.
Supporting: explicit worth-my-attention feedback and user-rated relevance, without sacrificing quality or breadth.
Breadth, source concentration and event deduplication safeguards hold even with AI-heavy feedback.
The reader discovers useful interests outside the onboarding profile.
Model evidence and self-reported human understanding are displayed independently, without a merged score.
Quality gates, undo/deletion, privacy and outage fallbacks pass acceptance fixtures.
CTR, dwell time, refresh frequency and notification opens are not optimization targets.

subgoals.description: Ground the design in verified research and explicit product policies.
subgoals.success_test: T1/T2 produce method fixtures, limitation notes and reviewed requirements.

subgoals.description: Provide broad, quality-screened content and a finite baseline reader.
subgoals.success_test: T3-T5 ingest authorized content and create constrained editions without duplicate events or clickbait promotion.

subgoals.description: Learn interests from explicit evidence with informative, constrained exploration.
subgoals.success_test: T6-T9 preserve unknown labels, frozen counterfactual scorer weights and protected discovery/public-interest slots.

subgoals.description: Display two honest trackers and safeguard profile data.
subgoals.success_test: T10/T12 distinguish self-report from model change and demonstrate complete undo/deletion and safe fallbacks.

subgoals.description: Evaluate contribution and decide whether epistemic personalization earns its complexity.
subgoals.success_test: T11/T13/T14 compare controlled baselines and report usefulness, breadth, frustration and limitations without attention metrics.

tasks.description: Implement reviewable quality screening and a labeled evaluation set.
tasks.expected_output: Explained quality decisions that distinguish clickbait from legitimate concise reporting.

tasks.description: Build finite baseline editions, original-source links and topic exploration paths.
Add independent usefulness/understanding feedback, notes, export, undo and reset.
tasks.expected_output: Separate evidence streams; absent feedback remains unlabeled; retained evidence can be replayed.

tasks.expected_output: Versioned multi-interest and article-fit states, drift-aware hypotheses and immutable paired model/baseline predictions recorded before feedback.

tasks.expected_output: Constrained hybrid selector; AI-heavy and multi-label/syndication adversarial fixtures pass.

tasks.description: Display gated interest-prediction improvement, an evidence-backed interest map and optional qualitative learning notes.
tasks.expected_output: Brier-skill dashboard with count/uncertainty/version qualifiers and cold-start gating; no combined knowledge percentage, unsupported causal explanation or gamification.

tasks.description: Replay policies and simulate cold start, drift, sparse feedback and catalog shifts.
tasks.expected_output: Quality/diversity, personalization, bandit, EG/EEG, novelty and random-discovery comparisons with explicit selection-bias limits.

tasks.description: Harden network exposure, source fetching, outages and feedback-derived deletion.
tasks.expected_output: SSRF/auth, model/source-outage and deletion/rebuild acceptance evidence.

tasks.description: Run a four-week personal pilot with predeclared balanced policy comparisons and weekly reflections.
tasks.expected_output: Descriptive usefulness, breadth, learning-self-report, response-burden and frustration report.

tasks.description: Decide which features to retain, tune, defer or remove based on pilot evidence.
tasks.expected_output: Reviewed product decision without claims of universal algorithm superiority or transferred theoretical guarantees.

plan.critical_path_note: Approximate integration path with tied branches at T9/T10 and T11/T12. Supplement/research delays may make T1 critical. One developer cannot execute independent tasks simultaneously without collaborators.

risks.risk: Incomplete code/training configuration and inconsistent theoretical metric definitions or proof steps.
risks.mitigation: Use verified main-paper formulas, document inconsistencies, retain baseline and make no coverage guarantees.

risks.risk: Sparse local inventory and content-access restrictions.
risks.mitigation: Curated authorized sources, metadata/link-out and explicit shortage explanations.

risks.risk: Quality screening suppresses legitimate brief or unfamiliar reporting.
risks.mitigation: Human-reviewed fidelity/evidence fixtures and correction controls.

risks.risk: Token diversity through subtopic labels and duplicate syndicated stories.
risks.mitigation: Broad multi-label caps, related-publisher metadata and event clustering.

risks.risk: Tiny personal history creates false certainty and poor representation.
risks.mitigation: Content-based cold start, separate uncertainty diagnostics, editable hypotheses and cautious calibration claims.

risks.risk: EG measures model instability or catalog artifacts rather than useful discovery.
risks.mitigation: Exact fixtures, full-catalog comparisons, temperature/anchor sensitivity and simpler exploration controls.

risks.risk: Exploration sacrifices relevance or overwhelms public-interest coverage.
risks.mitigation: Fixed protected lane budgets, quality gates and frustration evaluation.

risks.risk: Tracker implies verified comprehension or a percentage of the user understood.
risks.mitigation: Separate self-report and model-change labels; no merged score or gamification.

risks.risk: Selective feedback and changing inventory imply spurious improvement.
risks.mitigation: Identical eligibility/constraints, temporal holdout, response-rate reporting and descriptive limitations.

risks.risk: Profile leakage, unsafe URL fetching and incomplete deletion.
risks.mitigation: Private defaults, auth/network review, SSRF protection and retained-evidence rebuild tests.

risks.risk: Four-week single-user pilot is too small or feedback burden is excessive.
risks.mitigation: Optional feedback, weekly reflection, cautious descriptive conclusions and user-approved extension only.
